boundsDescription: Physical assembly bounds span x=-width/2 to +width/2, z=-depth to 0, and y=0 to the sum of ceiling board, service void, slab, screed, and finish thicknesses. Exploded display offsets are excluded from physical bounds.

slabThickness.note: Geometric layer thickness only; no structural capacity is calculated.

serviceVoid.note: Clear geometric void, not solid material.

explodeGap.note: Display-only separation between layers; excluded from physical build-up.
